unresolved: TRON_PER_USER_PROMPT_CHUNK_LIMIT - what a person sees with the value `0`. The code shows that the prompt position does not advance (src/tron/generation/context.cpp:74) and that an add of 0 tokens puts the request callback on the unchanged node (src/tron/scheduler/token_cache.cpp:516, src/tron/scheduler/full.cpp:192). Reading suggests that the request never finishes, but no line proves it. One run of `runtron` with the value `0` on a test host settles it.

TZ - whether `TZ` also moves the time of day in every log line of `rinzler` and `runtron`. The log pattern prints `%H:%M:%S` (src/system/spdlog.cpp:69) and `set_pattern` is called without a time type. The spdlog documentation gives local time as the default, but the checkout holds no spdlog source to confirm it. The `set_pattern` declaration in the spdlog header of the version that the build uses settles it. If confirmed, the row needs one more sentence, and `runtron` in "Read by".

RZ_RUNFILE_DIR - whether a program outside this repository (for example platformd) reads `/var/log/positron/rinzler-<pid>.run` on a deployed system. The repository holds only test readers (t/t_rinzler.cpp:291, t/proxy/rzproxy/launch.py:42). The platformd source or its owners settle it.
label_doubts: RZ_CHAT_TEMPLATE_KWARGS - Developers - README.md and doc/rinzler/qwen-protocol.md describe server-default chat_template_kwargs for served models, and this variable is the only way to set a server default (DEFAULT_CHAT_TEMPLATE_KWARGS is an empty object). So the condition "another Tron document describes it for deployed systems" may hold, and the label would then be Operators. Neither document names the variable. - README.md:774, doc/rinzler/qwen-protocol.md:54, h/rinzler/rinzler-config.hpp:145, src/rinzler.cpp:2392
